rubric_source: 115學測英文作文規準（虛構示例估分）

students.name: 虛構學生
paragraphs: The park have many trees. I enjoy walk there.
It is quiet, so I can relax after school.

scores.label: 內容
scores.reason: 有偏好及原因，細節仍少。

scores.label: 組織
scores.reason: 主題清楚，段落可再充實。

scores.label: 文法句構
scores.reason: 主謂一致與動名詞需訂正。

scores.label: 字彙拼字
scores.reason: 基本詞彙適切，可增加搭配詞。

students.deduction_reason: 測試資料，不套用正式考試扣分。

short_comment.en: Your reason is clear. Add a detail and check the verbs.
short_comment.zh: 理由清楚；再補一個細節，並檢查動詞。

full_comment.en: You explain how the park helps you relax. Keep this personal connection. Check subject-verb agreement and enjoy + -ing, then add a detail about the trees.
full_comment.zh: 你說明公園如何幫助自己放鬆，值得保留。接著檢查主謂一致、enjoy 後的動名詞，再補充樹木的細節。

tasks.instruction: 修正 have 與 enjoy walk，並說明一處理由。
tasks.instruction_en: Correct the verbs and explain one change.

tasks.instruction: 連接 The park… 與 I enjoy…，呈現明確關聯。
在 It is quiet… 後補一句：什麼細節讓你放鬆？
tasks.instruction_en: Add one detail about feeling relaxed.

reflections: 我能獨立檢查動詞與句界嗎？
選一處自己的修訂，說明效果及下一篇的檢查方法。
reflections_en: One change and my next check:

notes: G：The park 是單數主詞，現在式用 has。
sentences.advanced: The park is filled with leafy trees.
I enjoy strolling along its shaded paths.

sentences.original: It is quiet, so I can relax after school.
sentences.basic: It is quiet, so I can relax after school.
notes: 原句正確，可保留。進階版調整語氣，不代表原句有錯。
sentences.advanced: Its peaceful atmosphere helps me unwind after school.

basic.en: The park has many trees. I enjoy walking there.
basic.zh: 公園有很多樹。我喜歡在那裡散步。

basic.en: It is quiet, so I can relax after school.
basic.zh: 那裡很安靜，所以我可以在放學後放鬆。

advanced.en: The park is filled with leafy trees. I enjoy strolling along its shaded paths.
advanced.zh: 公園滿是枝葉茂密的樹木。我喜歡沿著樹蔭步道散步。

advanced.en: Its peaceful atmosphere helps me unwind after school. Listening to the leaves rustle makes me feel calm.
advanced.zh: 公園寧靜的氣氛幫助我在放學後放鬆。聽樹葉沙沙作響讓我感到平靜。（第二句為教師新增示範。）
